Entity.name: Main guarantor indicator
Entity.comment: An indicator specifying if a debtor is the main debtor.
Entity.commentInRDBMS: Main guarantor indicator distinguishes between those guarantors that have to be reported as main guarantor based on reasonable and risk-prudent considerations (e.g., subordination of liabilities, extent of the contribution to the joint protection), and those that are subordinated to the main guarantors. (Guidance notes to reporting agents on SHS regulation)
